source: docs/acceptance/ui-surface-audit.json (before) + the repair pass in this branch (after)

findings.headline: The plugin composes and all three official slots mount, but on the HEAD content the recovery-action row (id=null), the dashboard's only action (refresh-balance), 4 of 6 service actions, the whole advanced-policy surface, plugin permissions, the maintenance defer state and the human-gate count are dead or unrendered; the second ball (always-on-top window) is off by default. Two of these were being fixed in the dirty working tree while the audit ran (restart status/history, duplicate ball).

closed.fix: product-level actions are accepted without an id and fan out over the modules that answer (governance-bridge.cjs, mega/index.cjs productAction)
one vocabulary in app/core/contracts/service-actions.cjs, published in the snapshot and accepted by the bridge
dangerous actions are refused without confirm: true (bridge and Control Center) and the page asks in place first
the 38 keys and their write path are drawn in the official page and written through the host validator
the scheduler publishes waitingHuman/deferred and the Control Center republishes them as pending
serviceReports() answers for the whole runtime (28 plugins in this checkout)
the host publishes orb.mode and the in-UI ball stands down when the system window owns it
the service row draws the monitor’s held/maintenance reason and the plugin’s permissions

reachableSurfaces: the Control Center sections in the dock
the rest of the service roster in the official page
